info.name: Prisma Invalidate cache entries by tags

items.docs: Invalidates cached query results that were tagged with the specified cache tags. Up to 5 tags can be specified per request. Tags are alphanumeric strings with underscores, maximum 64 characters each. This endpoint is available on paid plans only.

Clears the entire cache for the current environment. Use with caution as this affects all cached queries in the environment and may cause a temporary increase in database load as the cache repopulates.
